text.en:
Any barangay member who, on Referendum Day, inspite of diligent efforts and through no fault
of his own could not locate his Barangay Center shall be allowed to vote in the Barangay Center nearest his

Any registered barangay member of a city/ municipality/municipal district, who on Referendum
Day is staying for any reason in another city/municipality/municipal district outside the province where he is
registered, may cast his vote in the Barangay Center nearest the place where he is temporarily staying.

Any barangay referendum committee which on account of the additional transient voters
mentioned above, runs short of ballots at any time of Referendum Day shall be authorized to borrow from the
nearest Barangay Referendum Committee under proper receipt sufficient number of ballots for their Barangay

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-three.
